title: 第17章 聚灵草第18章 天阴老人
slug: 全族助我加点我举族飞升天界
content_zh:
李北玄收回思绪，目光看向波光粼粼的湖面。
回想神念之力的玄妙，他再次沉下心神，将神念散发出去。
接着，神念没入湖面之中。
他想要尝试一番能否将神念之力探入水中。
然而，结果并没有让他失望。
当神念与湖水接触的瞬间，他突然感觉自己好像在水中生长出了一双眼睛，周围的一切都变得清晰可见。
只见湖面之下的景象生动展现在他的眼前，一条条银尾鱼在湖中自由穿梭。
就连鳞片也都看得清清楚楚。
这便是神念之力的玄妙之处，李北玄心中暗自感叹。
在神念感应之下，他感觉自己仿若置身于湖中一般，这种身临其境的感觉让他陶醉其中。
“神念之力果然玄妙无比，即使我盘膝坐在岸上，也能够如此清晰地看清湖里面的景象！”李北玄心中不禁感叹道。
然而，他并没有满足于此，他的神念继续向下延伸。
随着神念的下潜越来越深，他的视线也逐渐变得昏暗起来。
湖底的能见度明显降低，周围的景物开始变得模糊不清。
但李北玄也没有停下的意思，因为他想要测试一番神念之力的极限所在。
没过多久，李北玄终于是感觉到了一丝阻力，继续往下沉，他的视线也变得模糊起来。
突然，他的神念感应到在湖心岛底部位置散发着一缕荧光。
感受到那缕真切的荧光，李北玄不禁轻咦一声，“咦，这是什么？”
但由于神念之力已经接近极限，视线严重受阻，他也只能隐约看到那缕荧光。
李北玄迅速收回神念，目光看向湖底，心中对此好奇不已，“那散发着荧光的到底是什么东西？”

“有什么东西是会散发荧光的呢？”
他觉得湖底下方散发着荧光的那个东西，大概会是一个好东西。
因为他的神念之力刚刚在湖底的时候，感受到了灵气波动。
想到这，李北玄没有丝毫犹豫，便纵身一跃，身影瞬间没入了湖面之中。
落凤湖中，李北玄极速下潜，周身笼罩着一层薄薄的罡气。
几个呼吸之间，他便已经来到了刚才发现那缕荧光之处。
他看向湖底，只见一株草状植物在下方岩石下摇曳，并散发着缕缕荧光！
“这是？一阶灵草？”
李北玄看着下方那株晶莹剔透的植物，忍不住脱口而出。
因为那株植物与原主记忆中的灵草介绍很像！
转瞬之间，李北玄便来到了那株植物所在的岩石之下。
他仔细认真地扫视一番这株奇异植物，很快他便确定下来。
眼前这株草状植物，正是一阶灵草——聚灵草！
别看这只是一株一阶灵草，要知道他们湖心岛上所种植的药草，也不过普通药草而已。
在极为难得的条件之下才能蜕变成为伪灵草！
但相比于一阶灵草而言，这伪灵草却根本算不得什么！
因为一阶灵草能够帮助先天修士突破境界，这是伪灵草所不能做到的。
而且，这一阶灵草要是用来炼丹，效果会更加的好！
李北玄看着眼前这株聚灵草，心中忍不住大笑起来，“哈哈，运气来了果然挡都挡不住啊！”
content_en:
Li Beixuan retracted his thoughts and looked at the sparkling lake.
Recalling the mystery of the power of spiritual thoughts, he calmed down his mind again and radiated his spiritual thoughts.
Then, the divine thoughts submerged into the lake.
He wanted to try to see if he could penetrate the power of his spiritual thoughts into the water.
However, the results did not disappoint him.
The moment his mind came into contact with the lake water, he suddenly felt as if he had grown a pair of eyes in the water, and everything around him became clearly visible.
The scene under the lake surface vividly unfolded before his eyes, with silver-tailed fish swimming freely in the lake.
Even the scales can be seen clearly.
This is the mystery of the power of spiritual thoughts, Li Beixuan sighed secretly in his heart.
Under the influence of his spiritual thoughts, he felt as if he was in a lake. This immersive feeling made him intoxicated.
"The power of spiritual thoughts is really mysterious. Even if I sit cross-legged on the shore, I can still see the scene in the lake so clearly!" Li Beixuan couldn't help but sigh in his heart.
However, he was not satisfied with this, and his spiritual thoughts continued to extend downwards.
As his spiritual thoughts descended deeper and deeper, his vision gradually became dim.
The visibility at the bottom of the lake was significantly reduced, and the surrounding scenery began to become blurry.
But Li Beixuan had no intention of stopping, because he wanted to test the limits of his spiritual power.
Not long after, Li Beixuan finally felt a bit of resistance and continued to sink, and his vision became blurred.
Suddenly, his mind sensed a ray of fluorescence emitting from the bottom of the island in the middle of the lake.
Feeling the real fluorescence, Li Beixuan couldn't help but exclaimed, "Hey, what is this?"
However, because the power of his spiritual thoughts was close to its limit and his line of sight was severely blocked, he could only vaguely see the fluorescent light.
Li Beixuan quickly withdrew his thoughts and looked at the bottom of the lake, curious in his heart, "What is that fluorescent thing?"
"Is there anything that fluoresces?"
He thought that the fluorescent thing underneath the lake might be a good thing.
Because when his spiritual power was at the bottom of the lake, he felt the fluctuation of spiritual energy.
Thinking of this, Li Beixuan jumped up without any hesitation, and his figure instantly submerged into the lake.
In Luofeng Lake, Li Beixuan dived down very quickly, his whole body covered with a thin layer of Gang Qi.
In a few breaths, he had arrived at the place where he had just discovered the fluorescent light.
He looked at the bottom of the lake and saw a grass-like plant swaying under the rocks below, emitting wisps of fluorescence!
"This is? First-order spiritual grass?"
Li Beixuan looked at the crystal clear plant below and couldn't help blurting out.
Because that plant is very similar to the spiritual grass introduction in the original owner’s memory!
In an instant, Li Beixuan came under the rock where the plant was.
He scanned this strange plant carefully and carefully, and soon he was sure.
The grass-like plant in front of me is the first-order spiritual grass - Juling grass!
Even though this is just a first-order spiritual grass, you must know that the herbs they grow on the island in the middle of the lake are just ordinary herbs.
Only under extremely rare conditions can it transform into a pseudo-spiritual grass!
But compared to the first-order spiritual grass, this pseudo spiritual grass is nothing at all!
Because the first-level spiritual grass can help innate monks break through the realm, which is something that pseudo spiritual grass cannot do.
Moreover, if this level of spiritual grass is used to make elixirs, the effect will be even better!
Li Beixuan looked at the spirit-gathering grass in front of him and couldn't help but laugh in his heart, "Haha, you really can't stop luck when it comes!"
